title: Media Artifact WIT and SDK Contract
description: Add typed media artifact exchange to the plugin ABI: WIT surface (media-artifact record + consume-media/produce-media funcs in the `plugin` interface), native host-side calling machinery in framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs, web/dev host calling machinery in the JS dev host, and SDK default trait-method implementations (consume_media/produce_media) for DocumentApp/VcsDocumentApp in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs that reuse existing document snapshot ingest / read paths. Part of the typed media dataflow program (S/Semios media graph plugins exchanging typed media artifacts over the WASM component ABI). Sibling ticket R1b is concurrently adding MediaContract near framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's media_graph region — do not touch that file's media_graph region or s/plugin/rs/lib.rs's connect handlers.
